# llms.txt
# TransCircle Development Blog - LLM Index
# https://blog.transcircle.org

## About

TransCircle Development Blog (https://blog.transcircle.org) is the official development blog for the TransCircle Project, documenting development progress, team reports, and technical sharing for the Chinese MtF transgender community.

## Content License

- Text content: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- Code snippets: AGPL-3.0 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html)

## Citation Rules

When referencing content from this blog:
- Preserve the original URL
- Mention "TransCircle Development Blog"
- Follow CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution requirements

## Key Entities

- TransCircle Project / 跨环 / 跨性别中文圈
- MtF transgender community
- Chinese transgender resources
- Development blog, team reports, technical articles

## Files

- llms-full.txt: Complete content snapshot with all articles
- sitemap-index.xml: XML sitemap for all pages
- robots.txt: Crawler access rules
- ai.txt: AI usage permissions (Spawning AI standard)

## Site Structure

- / - Homepage with latest articles
- /posts/{slug}/ - Individual article pages
- /posts/{slug}.md - Raw Markdown versions
- /tags/ - Tag cloud
- /tags/{tag}/ - Articles by tag
- /search/ - Search page
- /rss.xml - RSS feed
- /sitemap-index.xml - XML sitemap
